facts.fact: 48 小时暴风雪，雷声比任何听过的都响，闪电炫目，雪没过客厅窗户
facts.anchor: Big snowstorm, lasting 48 hours. Thunder louder than I’ve ever heard.

facts.fact: 他自问：我的故事是什么？我现在在哪里？我会追逐闪电吗
facts.anchor: But what is my story? Where am I now? And will I chase the lightning?

facts.fact: 噩梦回归：天花板湿斑在梦里长成巨物，吞掉整栋房子，把他拖进充满树根与通道的黑暗
facts.anchor: Worst of all, the dreams were back. Bad dreams of the damp patch of the bedroom ceiling now grown enormous, engulfing the house

facts.fact: 梦里 Arthur 与 Caroline 在雪里互相追逐
facts.anchor: Dreams of Arthur and Caroline, chasing each other in the snow.

facts.fact: 梦里电塔骨骼嶙峋、以钢铁之腿大步行走，Rombold 与 Wade 以闪电为盾相击
facts.anchor: the pylon, skeletal; striding the moor on legs of steel; and of the old gods, Rombold and Wade, clashing shields of lightning.

facts.fact: 他梦见 Caroline，醒来时唇边是 Wilde 的诗句，带着玫瑰的香气
facts.anchor: and awoke with the scent of roses and the words of Wilde’s poem on his lips
